title: Item: Rituals Spellbook from Cult of Demogorgon
content:
• Shuushar's Bag of Holding from Nib had an Origami spellbook handout that said "Rituals written in abyssal". Wisdom save or madness level when trying to read, 1 save per ritual you read.

  • Rituals:

    • How to Summon Demogorgon. using faerzress-heavy area, need at least 5 cultist followers of Demogorgon to make an altar or ritual circle, with a stone statue or effigy in center. Must offer up multiple human sacrifices and spill a good amount of blood from followers and sacrifices both (offered sacrifices don't have to die, Demogorgon will happily kill them himself when he comes)

    • Narrak's Whorlstone Rituals. Jib already had the ritual book of Narrak's found in Whorlstone tunnel. Here's exactly what's needed to do Narrak's 2 rituals: Faerzress area, magic circle, several people Concentrating chanting, stone effigies of the targets, the names of the targets carved on the effigies, and ritual caster must be suffering from some form of Madness to perform either ritual successfully. Results: 1 ritual causes a one-headed creature to sprout a second head. 1 ritual allows the grafting of a severed head onto a living creature. Both result in permanent 2 heads and become rampaging servant under Demogorgon's control.

    • Ritual Circle at Blade Bazaar Docks where Shuushar had carved a magic circle into stone ground all around market area. What's needed to do this ritual? : Does NOT need faerzress, needs huge ritual circle carved around a 100ft radius area, needs 2-headed statue effigy of a target race with the race name carved in Abyssal language on it, needs at least 1 powerful spellcaster Concentrating in center, ritual caster must be suffering from some form of Madness to perform ritual successfully. Result: dominates 1 exact race of people (as the Dominate Person spell, and it counts as a magic spell), and after a couple minutes it starts to permanently split their heads and make them servants of Demogorgon!

    • Reversing any of these Rituals? All the same requirement as casting the ritual in the first place must be done again.
